<!--

===============================================================================

SAM Framework

Decision Record Template

===============================================================================



Purpose

-------

Use this template to document significant project, governance,

planning, operational, or management decisions that do not rise

to the level of an Architecture Decision Record (ADR).



Decision Records preserve project history and improve traceability.



They answer:



\- What decision was made?

\- Why was it made?

\- Who approved it?

\- What is affected?



Do not use this template for architectural decisions.



Architectural decisions belong in ADRs.



See:



\- ADR\_TEMPLATE.md

\- GOVERNANCE.md

\- REVIEW\_PROCESS.md

\- DECISION\_MODEL.md



===============================================================================

\-->

Author Checklist

# Author Checklist



\- \[ ] Context documented

\- \[ ] Decision clearly stated

\- \[ ] Reasoning documented

\- \[ ] Alternatives considered

\- \[ ] Expected impact described

\- \[ ] Review trigger defined

\- \[ ] Cross references validated



---



<!--

Common Mistakes

---------------

\-->



# Common Mistakes



\- Using a Decision Record instead of an ADR.

\- Omitting the reasoning.

\- Recording meeting minutes instead of decisions.

\- Leaving ownership undefined.

\- Forgetting follow-up actions.

\- Treating assumptions as decisions.



---



<!--

Completion Checklist

--------------------

\-->



# Completion Checklist



\- \[ ] Metadata complete

\- \[ ] Review completed

\- \[ ] Status updated

\- \[ ] Cross references verified

\- \[ ] Ready for publication



---



# Summary



Summarize the decision in one or two paragraphs.



State:



\- what was decided,

\- why,

\- who approved it,

\- and what should happen next.
